titleEn: The Score of Students Solving Math Expression
title: 解出数学表达式的学生分数
summary: 表达式含单数字、加号和乘号；正确答案得五分，按任意错误括号顺序但运算本身正确且结果不超一千得两分，求总分。
insight: 栈式计算乘法优先的正确值。区间 DP 枚举每个运算符作为最后运算，集合保存所有不同括号化结果且只保留不超一千者。
pitfalls: 错误括号结果集合需去重
中间结果超过一千可丢弃

solutions.title: 正确求值与区间结果集合 DP
solutions.idea: 分别计算标准答案和所有括号化可能答案。
steps: 解析数字与运算符；用累计项计算标准乘法优先值
dp[left][right] 集合：单数字；区间按 split 合并左右集合并执行对应运算，保留 <=1000
遍历学生答案：等于 correct 加五，否则在全集加二

code.java: class Solution { public int scoreOfStudents(String s,int[] answers){int count=(s.length()+1)/2;int[] numbers=new int[count];char[] operators=new char[count-1];for(int i=0;i<count;i++){numbers[i]=s.charAt(2*i)-'0';if(i+1<count)operators[i]=s.charAt(2*i+1);}int correct=0,term=numbers[0];for(int i=0;i<operators.length;i++)if(operators[i]=='*')term*=numbers[i+1];else{correct+=term;term=numbers[i+1];}correct+=term;Set<Integer>[][] dp=new Set[count][count];for(int i=0;i<count;i++){dp[i][i]=new HashSet<>();dp[i][i].add(numbers[i]);}for(int length=2;length<=count;length++)for(int left=0;left+length<=count;left++){int right=left+length-1;dp[left][right]=new HashSet<>();for(int split=left;split<right;split++)for(int a:dp[left][split])for(int b:dp[split+1][right]){int value=operators[split]=='+'?a+b:a*b;if(value<=1000)dp[left][right].add(value);}}int score=0;for(int answer:answers)score+=answer==correct?5:dp[0][count-1].contains(answer)?2:0;return score;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun scoreOfStudents(s:String,answers:IntArray):Int{val count=(s.length+1)/2;val numbers=IntArray(count){s[2*it]-'0'};val operators=CharArray(count-1){s[2*it+1]};var correct=0;var term=numbers[0];for(i in operators.indices)if(operators[i]=='*')term*=numbers[i+1] else{correct+=term;term=numbers[i+1]};correct+=term;val dp=Array(count){arrayOfNulls<MutableSet<Int>>(count)};for(i in 0 until count)dp[i][i]=hashSetOf(numbers[i]);for(length in 2..count)for(left in 0..count-length){val right=left+length-1;val values=HashSet<Int>();for(split in left until right)for(a in dp[left][split]!!)for(b in dp[split+1][right]!!){val value=if(operators[split]=='+')a+b else a*b;if(value<=1000)values.add(value)};dp[left][right]=values};return answers.sumOf{if(it==correct)5 else if(it in dp[0][count-1]!!)2 else 0}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int scoreOfStudents(string s,vector<int>& answers){int count=(s.size()+1)/2;vector<int> numbers(count);vector<char> operators(count-1);for(int i=0;i<count;++i){numbers[i]=s[2*i]-'0';if(i+1<count)operators[i]=s[2*i+1];}int correct=0,term=numbers[0];for(int i=0;i<(int)operators.size();++i)if(operators[i]=='*')term*=numbers[i+1];else{correct+=term;term=numbers[i+1];}correct+=term;vector<vector<set<int>>> dp(count,vector<set<int>>(count));for(int i=0;i<count;++i)dp[i][i].insert(numbers[i]);for(int length=2;length<=count;++length)for(int left=0;left+length<=count;++left){int right=left+length-1;for(int split=left;split<right;++split)for(int a:dp[left][split])for(int b:dp[split+1][right]){int value=operators[split]=='+'?a+b:a*b;if(value<=1000)dp[left][right].insert(value);}}int score=0;for(int answer:answers)score+=answer==correct?5:dp[0][count-1].count(answer)?2:0;return score;} };
